newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market rate slides to 9.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market rate slides to 9.3 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average money market rate slid a full percentage point to 9.3 percent on Thursday amid strong liquidity and a large volume of call-money deals.
Dealers put daily settlements at a modest 25.5 million kuna, with almost 100 million kuna surplus on the supply side.
Fresh deals amounted to 18.5 million of which 17 million was call money granted at a steady 8 percent rate.
Banks extended three-month deals at 18 percent and rolled over one-week loans at 9-11 percent.
The central bank's kuna midrates for Friday eased to 6.4081 from 6.3864 against the dollar and to 3.5682 from 3.5650 versus the German mark.
